suite: r1106 original microphone lifecycle and presets readability
method: Non-browser Node VM executes shipped renderMixer/chnCardHTML/ambAccItem/syncAmbAccHeights, the original button-binding statement and notes preference script. A controlled DOM parses their markup and models destructive innerHTML, node movement, EventTarget listeners and active-element detach/refocus. It does not preserve nodes automatically.
limitations: No browser engine, computed styles, geometry, screenshots, native keyboard/focus, microphone permissions, recording hardware or audible output was exercised.
Contrast guard applies to the declared heading color/surface pair over black and white scene pixels; visual acceptance remains separate.
